::: {#rem-walk-names}
#### Other names for walks

Books do not agree on these names.
Some, including Kameron Decker Harris's notes for this course, call a walk (@def-walk) a "path",
call a trail (@def-trail) a "simple path",
and call a closed walk of positive length a circuit.
Others call a cycle (@def-graph-cycle) a "simple circuit".
When you read about graphs elsewhere, check which definitions the author uses.

:::
